verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only a local preview server with hot reload. That is not a shareable, per-pull-request preview deployment. One item says Fern 'offers two ways to preview documentation changes' but never states that either is a hosted, shareable URL generated automatically for each PR, so no affirmative support exists for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, every docs pull request gets a shareable preview deployment before it merges
